fields.summary_ko.0: Morgan Stanley reduced its price target for SK Hynix by 38% (KRW 2.6 million → KRW 1.6 million) while simultaneously forecasting that KOSPI can sustain the 10,000 level over the next 3-5 years.
fields.summary_ko.1: KOSPI shareholder return ratio is expected to increase from current 35% to 50-60% within 3-5 years, and ROE is projected to improve from 8% to 13.5-14.5% by 2030.
fields.summary_ko.2: Analyst Sean Kim proactively lowered semiconductor earnings forecasts due to concerns about achieving growth post-2028 and highlighted supply surplus risks.
